cue: The inventory item notes indicate firmware_lock: true, meaning the returned unit is firmware-locked and must be securely wiped and QA'd before returning to service.

matchers.why: Explicit flag marking the unit as firmware-locked (direct signal to quarantine)
Alternate wording embedding the firmware_lock flag in metadata (distinct phrasing carrying same signal)
Instruction to perform secure wipe and QA before returning to service (signals the handling requirement/quarantine)
Indicates the unit is locked to a serial and therefore not safe to list until unlocked/wiped (signals restriction)
